decisive_items: High titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody
Multinucleated giant cells between necrotic tissue and viable inflammatory cells
response.rationale: Anti-CCP positivity and methotrexate/sulfasalazine use indicate rheumatoid arthritis; the leptomeningeal enhancement and biopsy showing necrotizing subarachnoid exudate with giant cells, plasma cells, and Russell bodies are characteristic of rheumatoid meningitis. Neurosarcoidosis is the closest mimic but lacks systemic sarcoidosis and is less consistent with the anti-CCP/RA context.

rejected.why: No evidence of vasculitis on biopsy and normal MRA contradict CNS vasculitis; elevated inflammatory markers and anti-CCP are explained by rheumatoid disease.
Oligoclonal bands correspond to serum rather than being CSF-restricted, and leptomeningeal enhancement with necrotizing exudate is atypical for multiple sclerosis.
Leptomeningeal enhancement and giant cells can mimic neurosarcoidosis, but chest CT is normal and the anti-CCP/RA history strongly favors rheumatoid meningitis.
